page.meta_description: Connect with Rise City. Share a prayer request, ask about Bible study or baptism, or take your next step.
page.intro: We would love to get to know you. Whether you are new, have a prayer request, or want to explore your next step with Jesus, there is a place for you here.
page.callout_text: We believe faith grows through meaningful connection. Tell us a little about yourself, and someone from Rise City can follow up.
page.microcopy: A FEW DETAILS. LESS THAN A MINUTE.

form.heading: LET’S CONNECT.
form.description: Complete this brief form and we’ll know how best to reach you.
form.message_label: Anything else you’d like us to know? (optional)
form.privacy_text: Your information is used to respond to your request. Please don’t include medical, financial, or other sensitive details.

delivery.service_description: Submissions are securely sent through FormSubmit to the Rise City email inbox. A one-time email confirmation is required to activate delivery.

closing.title: RISE IN FAITH. WALK WITH CHRIST.
closing.message: We’re glad you’re taking this step.
